name: Mai
source:
The younger twin sister. Big-breasted. Quick-witted, dexterous, and a genius type. Bright, cheerful, and proactive. Skilled at being affectionate and devoted to her sister.

She returned to Japan for a certain reason, but is deeply grateful to her uncle for accepting her.

She adores her sister and calls her ‘Sa-chan’. She spends her days doting on both of them while also being considerate of her sister.

She doesn't brag about having larger breasts than her sister; in fact, she finds it rather bothersome.

[From the [url=https://fandc.co.jp/natsuh2/index00.html#character7]Official website[/url]]
